direction: The owner liked round 196 and asked to continue with the local Blender exteriors.
scope: Review the models against the original paintings before any game replacement. Windows uses round 172.
registration: Each ship uses the unchanged gallery camera, exposure, studio and scale from round 196. Detail views recenter on the painting rectangle and increase sampling.
lighting: Both local Cycles studies include 24-sample renders with the key turned 65 degrees and studio lights off. Original lights and exposure are unknown.
appearance_method: Display-referred Rec.709-weighted brightness on an 8-bit sRGB raster. Glacier uses 3 by 3 neighborhoods at 16 interior and eight collar marks. Delta uses three curved strips and seven independent columns, 15 pixels wide with 13 vertical offsets. Warm red-minus-blue weights locate each row. No detected row yields no center. Local measurements do not rate whole-ship likeness.
